package node

// The generator of internal/node/testdata/releases/<tag>/. It is not part
// of the tree's tests: scripts/release-db.sh copies it into a copy of a
// tagged release's source and runs it there, so the databases are written
// by that release's own code. It uses only test helpers and API that
// every release from v0.2.0 has. The output is one SQL text file per
// machine (schema, rows and user_version) and manifest.json, which
// TestDatabasesFromEachReleaseOpenReplayAndKeepWorking compares with what
// the current code reads back.

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/wallter/a2p2/internal/core"
	"github.com/wallter/a2p2/internal/store"
)

type genRoom struct {
	Label   string   `json:"label"`
	Records int      `json:"records"`
	Members []string `json:"members"`
	Admins  []string `json:"admins"`
}

type genMachine struct {
	ID     string                 `json:"id"`
	Agents []string               `json:"agents"`
	Rooms  map[string]genRoom `json:"rooms"`
}

func TestWriteReleaseDatabases(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("A2P2_RELEASE_DB_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("A2P2_RELEASE_DB_OUT not set")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	clock := lclock()
	net := newMemNet()
	a := newPNode(t, net, "a", newLNode(t, "a", clock))
	b := newPNode(t, net, "b", newLNode(t, "b", clock))
	c := newPNode(t, net, "c", newLNode(t, "c", clock))

	// A room of three: b with history, c without; c leaves by removal
	// after it wrote.
	room := a.create("team")
	a.change(room, Change{Kind: core.EntryAdd, Target: b.id, Name: "bee", History: true})
	a.change(room, Change{Kind: core.EntryAdd, Target: c.id, Name: "cee", History: false})
	for _, p := range []*pnode{b, c} {
		p.pin(room, a.lnode)
		p.pull(room, a.lnode)
	}
	a.register("alice")
	b.register("bob")
	c.register("carol")
	hello := a.send(room, "alice", "hello from a")
	b.mustPull(room, a, PullOpts{})
	a.tick()
	if _, err := b.m.Send(ctx, Draft{Room: room, Agent: "bob", Text: "a reply", ReplyTo: hello}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	a.tick()
	ask, err := a.m.Send(ctx, Draft{Room: room, Agent: "alice", Text: "pick one", Choices: []string{"yes", "no"}, AskHandled: true})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	a.tick()
	edited := a.send(room, "alice", "first text")
	a.tick()
	if _, err := a.m.Replace(ctx, room, "alice", edited, "second text"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	a.tick()
	gone := a.send(room, "alice", "withdrawn later")
	a.tick()
	if _, err := a.m.Withdraw(ctx, room, "alice", gone); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	c.send(room, "carol", "from c")
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		b.mustPull(room, a, PullOpts{})
		c.mustPull(room, a, PullOpts{})
		a.mustPull(room, b, PullOpts{})
		a.mustPull(room, c, PullOpts{})
	}
	a.tick()
	if _, err := a.m.Send(ctx, Draft{Room: room, Agent: "alice", Text: "to bob", To: []core.Addressee{{Node: b.id, Agent: "bob"}}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	a.change(room, Change{Kind: core.EntryRemove, Target: c.id})
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		b.mustPull(room, a, PullOpts{})
		a.mustPull(room, b, PullOpts{})
	}
	// bob reads his inbox and confirms what it showed.
	iv, err := b.m.Inbox(ctx, room, "bob")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := b.m.Showed(ctx, room, "bob", iv.Entries, true); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var reads []store.Read
	for _, e := range iv.Entries {
		reads = append(reads, store.Read{Key: e.Key, Version: e.Version})
	}
	if _, err := b.m.Seen(ctx, room, "bob", reads); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// and reports the question handled.
	a.tick()
	if _, err := b.m.Handled(ctx, room, "bob", ask.ID); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	a.mustPull(room, b, PullOpts{})
	// A second room that only a holds.
	solo := a.create("solo")
	a.send(solo, "alice", "a note to self")

	if err := os.MkdirAll(out, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	manifest := map[string]genMachine{}
	for _, p := range []*pnode{a, b, c} {
		m := genMachine{ID: p.id, Rooms: map[string]genRoom{}}
		for _, r := range []string{room, solo} {
			if _, ok := p.r.rooms[r]; !ok {
				continue
			}
			st := p.state(r)
			label := "team"
			if r == solo {
				label = "solo"
			}
			m.Rooms[r] = genRoom{Label: label, Records: len(p.records(r)),
				Members: genSorted(st.Members), Admins: genSorted(st.Admins)}
		}
		switch p.name {
		case "a":
			m.Agents = []string{"alice"}
		case "b":
			m.Agents = []string{"bob"}
		case "c":
			m.Agents = []string{"carol"}
		}
		manifest[p.name] = m
		if err := p.st.Close(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := genDump(p.path, filepath.Join(out, p.name+".sql")); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	j, err := json.MarshalIndent(manifest, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "manifest.json"), append(j, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func genSorted(xs []string) []string {
	ys := slices.Clone(xs)
	slices.Sort(ys)
	if ys == nil {
		ys = []string{}
	}
	return ys
}

// dumpDatabase writes the schema and every row of the database at path as
// SQL text, ending with its user_version.
func genDump(path, to string) error {
	db, err := sql.Open("sqlite", "file:"+path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer db.Close()
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString("-- Written by internal/node/testdata/releases/gen_test.go.txt (scripts/release-db.sh).\n")
	type obj struct{ typ, name, sql string }
	var objs []obj
	rows, err := db.Query(`SELECT type, name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE sql IS NOT NULL AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY CASE type WHEN 'table' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, name`)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for rows.Next() {
		var o obj
		if err := rows.Scan(&o.typ, &o.name, &o.sql); err != nil {
			rows.Close()
			return err
		}
		objs = append(objs, o)
	}
	rows.Close()
	tables := []string{}
	for _, o := range objs {
		if o.typ == "table" {
			b.WriteString(o.sql + ";\n")
			tables = append(tables, o.name)
		}
	}
	var hasSeq int
	if err := db.QueryRow(`SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE name = 'sqlite_sequence'`).Scan(&hasSeq); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if hasSeq == 1 {
		tables = append(tables, "sqlite_sequence")
	}
	for _, tn := range tables {
		if err := genRows(db, &b, tn); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", tn, err)
		}
	}
	for _, o := range objs {
		if o.typ != "table" {
			b.WriteString(o.sql + ";\n")
		}
	}
	var v int
	if err := db.QueryRow(`PRAGMA user_version`).Scan(&v); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "PRAGMA user_version = %d;\n", v)
	return os.WriteFile(to, []byte(b.String()), 0o644)
}

func genRows(db *sql.DB, b *strings.Builder, table string) error {
	rows, err := db.Query(`SELECT * FROM "` + table + `" ORDER BY rowid`)
	if err != nil {
		// A table without a rowid.
		if rows, err = db.Query(`SELECT * FROM "` + table + `"`); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	cols, err := rows.Columns()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for rows.Next() {
		vals := make([]any, len(cols))
		ptrs := make([]any, len(cols))
		for i := range vals {
			ptrs[i] = &vals[i]
		}
		if err := rows.Scan(ptrs...); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		parts := make([]string, len(vals))
		for i, v := range vals {
			switch x := v.(type) {
			case nil:
				parts[i] = "NULL"
			case int64:
				parts[i] = fmt.Sprint(x)
			case float64:
				parts[i] = fmt.Sprint(x)
			case bool:
				if x {
					parts[i] = "1"
				} else {
					parts[i] = "0"
				}
			case []byte:
				parts[i] = "X'" + hex.EncodeToString(x) + "'"
			case string:
				parts[i] = "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(x, "'", "''") + "'"
			default:
				return fmt.Errorf("column %s: unexpected %T", cols[i], v)
			}
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(b, "INSERT INTO \"%s\" VALUES(%s);\n", table, strings.Join(parts, ","))
	}
	return rows.Err()
}
